dailyLog.notesHint: How was your day? Any meals skipped, soreness, etc.

measurements.hint: Two complementary types — both feed the AI coach
measurements.reportHint: Upload a screenshot from Fitdays, InBody, Tanita, Withings, or any BIA scale app — or a PDF from ISAK/Holway anthropometric assessment. AI extracts all values automatically.

measurements.pdfReady: PDF loaded — click Extract to analyze
measurements.tapeHint: Manual circumference measurements taken with a tape measure.

exerciseLog.photoHint: Take a photo of your workout notes or gym screen — AI will fill in the exercises.
exerciseLog.noDataFound: No exercise data detected in the photo.
exerciseLog.analyzeError: Could not analyze photo. Please try again.

mealPlans.uploadHint: Supported formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, PNG
mealPlans.contentExtracted: Nutrition data extracted by AI — ready for analysis
mealPlans.deleteError: Could not delete plan. Please try again.

chat.title: AI Coach

routines.title: Workout Routines
routines.emptyDay: No exercises in this day yet. Add an exercise to get started.
routines.cancelSessionHint: This will discard this session and its progress. Your saved routine and previous workouts will remain.
routines.loadError: Could not load your workouts. Check your connection and try again.
routines.empty: No routines yet. Generate one with AI or build your own.
routines.deleteConfirm: Delete routine "{{name}}"? Past sessions are kept.
routines.generateHint: The AI coach will build a routine from your profile (goal, equipment, session length). Optionally tell it what to focus on.
routines.focusPlaceholder: e.g. upper body strength, legs, full body...
routines.notesPlaceholder: e.g. shoulder feels tender, no barbell today...
routines.generateError: Could not generate a routine. Please try again.
routines.libraryError: Exercise library unavailable — you can still add custom exercises.
routines.gifUrlHint: Optional: paste a link to an animated demo GIF
routines.aiUnavailable: AI adjustment unavailable — using your routine targets for today.
routines.noProgressForDay: There are no completed workouts for this day yet. Choose a day with saved workouts to see your progress.
routines.noChartData: Complete a session with weights to see progress here.

demo.banner: Demo mode — sample data stored on this device only. AI replies are simulated.

report.title: Weekly AI Report
report.historicalSource: Measurements from {{source}} provide historical context. No further readings from this source are expected; current advice and targets use your own tracking and training.
report.recordedWeek_one: You have {{count}} completed workout recorded this week.
report.recordedWeek_other: You have {{count}} completed workouts recorded this week.
report.fallbackSummary: These records are a starting point for reviewing your training. Your own scale or manual measurements can build a separate baseline for body changes.
report.fallbackFocus: Log the completed sets, repetitions and loads of your next planned workout.
report.empty: Get an AI summary of your training week — volume, weight trend, wins, and what to focus on next.
report.error: Could not generate the report. Please try again.

forecast.title: Goal Forecast
forecast.eta: At this rate you'll reach {{goal}} kg around {{date}}.
forecast.reached: You've reached your goal weight — time to set a new target? 🎉
forecast.stalled: Your weight has been flat for a while. If you expected it to move, ask the coach to review your calories.
forecast.movingAway: You're trending away from your goal ({{kg}} kg/week). Worth a check-in with the coach.
forecast.insufficient: Log your weight a few more days to unlock a forecast.
forecast.noGoal: Set a goal weight in your profile to see a forecast.

meals.snapHint: Take or upload a photo of your meal — AI estimates the calories and macros.
meals.analyzeError: Couldn't read that photo. Try a clearer picture of the food.
meals.reviewEstimate: Review the AI estimate, then log it
meals.demoUnavailable: Meal photo analysis is available in the full app after signing in — it uses live AI to estimate calories and macros from your photos.

pendingApproval.title: Awaiting Approval
pendingApproval.body: Your account has been created and is pending approval. You'll get access as soon as the administrator reviews your request.
pendingApproval.autoUpdate: This page updates automatically — no need to refresh.

rejected.title: Access Denied
rejected.body: Your account request was not approved. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the administrator.

workoutHistory.workoutSaved: Workout completed and saved. Your recorded sets are shown below.
workoutHistory.sessionMissing: This workout could not be found. Refresh history to check again.
workoutHistory.title: Workout history
workoutHistory.description: Your saved sessions, including routines you no longer use. Open a session to review the sets you actually completed.
workoutHistory.loadError: We couldn't load your workout history. Try again.
workoutHistory.emptyDescription: Start a workout from one of your routines. Your progress and completed sessions will appear here.
workoutHistory.invalidRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.
workoutHistory.noResults: No sessions match these filters. Clear the filters or try a different date.
workoutHistory.completedOnly: Only sets marked as completed are shown and counted in the volume (weight × reps). A weight of 0 means no external load was recorded.
workoutHistory.noExerciseData: No exercise details were saved for this session.
workoutHistory.incompleteSets_one: {{count}} set not completed; excluded from the total.
workoutHistory.incompleteSets_other: {{count}} sets not completed; excluded from the total.

workoutSessionUx.saveError: We couldn't save your changes. Check your connection and try again.
workoutSessionUx.readOnly: Completed workout · edit to make corrections

measurementHistory.hint: Browse saved measurements and body composition reports by date. Open a record to see all results and its original file.
measurementHistory.previewHint: If the preview cannot be displayed, use Open original report.
measurementHistory.empty: No measurements in the loaded records yet. Add a record or load older dates.
measurementHistory.loadError: Measurement history could not be loaded.
measurementHistory.reportsError: Uploaded reports could not be loaded.

exerciseProgress.empty: Complete a set to see your repetitions here.
exerciseProgress.oneSession: Complete another session to compare your repetitions.
exerciseProgress.compare: Each line follows one set. The weight used appears in the details for each session.

weightInput.chooseUnit: Choose kg or lb to match your equipment.
weightInput.workoutUnitHint: Your default unit for training. Body measurements stay in kg.
weightInput.saveUnitError: The workout unit could not be saved. Try again.

sessionEditor.title: Edit workout
sessionEditor.timeHint: Times use your device's local time. Leave unknown times empty.
sessionEditor.partialTime: Add both start and completion times to calculate the duration.
sessionEditor.historyOnly: Changes apply to this workout. Your saved routine targets stay unchanged.
sessionEditor.activeDefaults: Changes to an active workout also update the weights and reps used next time.
sessionEditor.noExercises: No exercises. Add an exercise before saving.
sessionEditor.noSets: No sets. Add a set before saving.
sessionEditor.invalidName: Enter a workout name and a name for each exercise.
sessionEditor.invalidTime: Enter valid start and completion times, or leave unknown times empty.
sessionEditor.invalidOrder: Completion must be at or after the start time.
sessionEditor.invalidSets: Every exercise needs at least one set. Reps must be whole numbers and weights must be valid numbers, all zero or greater.
sessionEditor.emptyWorkout: Add at least one exercise before saving.

workoutManagement.deleteHint: This removes this session and its entries from the daily log. Your routine and other workouts remain.
